items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: that's when we had Jimmy Forrest with us.

ctx.x: Mushy, mushy, yeah. We used that over there. See, we used that to add a little Japanese to it. Because quite a few Japanese would come to all those shows we played in Japan, see. And we sang that, boy, the Japanese, they fell in love with it. They just clapped.

But that 1945 trip there was a great trip. The band didn't do so hot in '46. But the band went back in '47, that's when we had Jimmy Forrest with us. We played that (musical sounds), remember that song? ("Sunrise Serenade"-ed.)
